```ts
      watercolor: "watercolor";
    }>;
  },
  $strict

```

The Avatar v1 schema, refined against every built-in character's facts: the one
callers should actually parse untrusted data with. (The unrefined envelope lives
at `@fungi.computer/sprite/avatar`'s `avatarEnvelopeSchema`, for a caller
building a different catalog.)

### deriveAgentAvatar()

```ts
function deriveAgentAvatar(member, agentColors, seed, avoid?): object;
```

Derive an Agent's avatar from its creator's: `deriveAgentAvatar` bound to the
built-in character catalog, so the Hub, Grove's create preview, the TUI and
local Agents all compute the same result without each wiring the catalog through
themselves.
